parameters.query:
SELECT b.booking_id, c.phone, b.scheduled_start, s.name_en AS service_name, biz.business_name, biz.twilio_number AS twilio_from 
FROM bookings b 
JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id 
JOIN services s ON b.service_id = s.service_id 
JOIN businesses biz ON b.business_id = biz.business_id 
WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' 
  AND b.scheduled_start >= NOW() + interval '24 hours' 
  AND b.scheduled_start < NOW() + interval '25 hours'
